subject: oop
question: Name the method used to start the execution of a thread.
title: Run Is Not Start
hook: Creating the cook does not start the cooking.
answer: The start() method of the Thread class begins execution of a thread.
start() makes the JVM create a new path of execution and then call run().
Calling run() directly is just a normal method call in the same thread (no new thread).
run() holds the work; start() launches it.
